name: Roon
summary: Plays from Roon: the player is a Roon device, through its own output, untouched with the equaliser off.
label: Roon Active
notice: Roon Bridge, which makes the player a Roon device, is Roon Labs' software: it is downloaded from Roon Labs when Roon is added, and keeps itself up to date, under Roon's terms (roon.app/en/termsandconditions). It plays from a Roon Core on the same network.
